Changes.note: “Create N sessions” adds every session of the preview to the course at once; a week its date falls in that does not exist is created as “Hafta N”, and the link goes to the first session at most. Talebe enrolled in the course see the sessions on its page; while the course is published, those who have not turned calendar invitations off are e-mailed an invitation once a session is within 30 days. The sessions are not undone together: each is cancelled on the Sessions page or hidden from the syllabus, and a calendar cancellation is sent then.
